transcript.text: Hello, welcome to the On Print Shop add-ons tutorial series.
In today's video we will explore our custom art and logo maker tool.
A logo becomes the face of any business.
Whether you teach art, run a gallery or are an artist, we have all the layouts you require for the right branding.
With a few simple steps, your customers can turn their creative business venture into a masterpiece.
On Print Shop Custom Art Maker provides you with all the tools you require to create a custom logo.
Your customers will find hundreds of impeccable designs they'll not have to surf to look for inspiration.
Our gallery of creative art logos will help your customers create an aesthetic sense into a compelling brand.
As this is an add on, you can contact our technical team to get this module enabled in your On Print Shop store.
Once this is enabled, you can create art and logos from your side or even allow your customers to do so.
So let's get started.

In the front store, when the customer selects any product for customization in the Designer Studio, the art layout popup will automatically appear and they will have the art layout menu in the left panel.
When the customer clicks on the art layout in the Designer Studio, they will have two options to create the art layout.
With Create Artwork they can create an art or logo from scratch and with Try It they will have the option to choose and modify the system generated designs.
With Try It customers can create art in three simple steps.
In the first step, they need to give their color preference and then move to the next step.
In the second step, they need to enter the text that they want to have in the design such as on print shop your IT partner and then click on the See your designs to see the system generated designs.
In the last step, the customer can select the artwork to apply to the design canvas.
Also, there are several icons that your customers can choose from and create.
A design admin can also upload these icons from the admin panel.
Once the customer selects the artwork, the system will ask them to save the artwork and then apply it to the product design.
When the artwork is applied on the canvas, the customer can edit it too.
They can apply different colors to the different elements.
For text elements, there is an open room to change the font type.
Once the customer is done with the design, they can continue with placing the order.
If the customer wants to see and make changes to the designs, they can access them using the My Saved Artworks button from the Image Gallery section.
This is how your customers can create artwork or logos in the Designer Studio.
Now let's see how to configure this from the Admin panel.
Go to the Admin panel under the Templates section and click on the Art layout.
On this page you will find all the art and logos created with the option to edit the details, edit the design or even delete the layout.
To create an art layout, click on the Add button from the top right corner.
Enter the title for this layout.
Art Layout 23.
Now select the product for which you want to create this layout.
We are creating for all product types from all the product types.
You can choose if you want to create this layout for each and every product from the system or for some specific one.
Let's keep all products here.
Finally, you have to decide if this is a design layout or a word layout.
Let's create a word layout, enable the status as Active and click on Save and Continue.
As soon as you click on Save and Continue, you will be redirected to the Designer Studio where you can create art using the text clip art and predefined layouts.
Let's create one piece of art using a predefined layout and then add some clip art and do some settings.
Once done, click on the Continue button.
You can see the newly created art in the listing.
This is how you can create art layouts from the admin panel.
Now to give your customers the facility to create art or logos, you first need to enable a setting.
For this, go to Designer Studio and click on the Studio settings.
In the search box, type Art Maker, then enable this setting and then save on the front store.
Whenever the customer lands in the designer studio, they will have this art layout option in the left panel.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
